name: Martha Higgins
psychographics: Values independence and keeping her mind active; worries about running out of money before she runs out of time.
current_solutions: Uses a basic Nokia flip phone for calls only; still receives her pension via paper bank-in slips at the post office; buys groceries at the local Iceland supermarket using a paper loyalty card.
frustration: Called her bank at 2:15 PM on a Tuesday to query an unexpected £12 charge; spent 22 minutes in an automated loop before being told the line was closed for lunch and to call back the following morning.
decision_style: Reads the Which? magazine cover-to-cover before trying any new product; compares prices in three different physical shops before committing.
voice: Soft-spoken but firm, speaks in complete sentences, rarely uses slang, often pauses to check if she is being understood on the phone.
